div.p: Casa Magna is a Portuguese brand founded in 2017, defined by a sophisticated and cosmopolitan design language. Created from the desire to bring beauty and comfort into everyday life, the brand is dedicated to crafting luxury furniture with refined finishes and exceptional attention to detail.

Every piece is made to order and handcrafted in Portugal, shaped around the unique vision and aspirations of each client. We align traditional craftsmanship with the most advanced technology, allowing us to achieve outstanding precision and respond to even the most demanding design projects.

At Casa Magna, furniture is more than a functional object. It is a statement of character and a reflection of personal lifestyle. Whether for a peaceful countryside villa or an elegant city apartment, each piece brings intention, purpose and soul into the spaces it helps create.

div.p: Our design process is shaped by a clear creative vision that seamlessly blends aesthetics with functionality. Every piece begins with meticulous material selection and a deep commitment to quality, ensuring a balance between beauty, comfort and durability. More than furniture, our creations are conceived as design statements that express character and atmosphere. Each piece is crafted to tell a story, enriching the space with presence, purpose and individuality.

div.p: Every piece is the result of a seamless union between design excellence and luxury craftsmanship. Handcrafted in Portugal by skilled artisans, our furniture is created with precision, care and mastery that has been refined over decades. By combining artisanal techniques with advanced production technology and a careful selection of noble materials, we ensure exceptional quality in both structure and finish.
